test.in: The pipes are ours, not StdoutPipe's: exec closes those at Wait, and this process must outlive that to bound a reader itself. See drainGrace.
test.out: The pipes are ours, not StdoutPipe's: exec closes those at Wait.

test.in: Wait reports only once both spools have seen their end: reap closes the relays after the grace, releasing a stream a grandchild still holds open.
test.out: Wait reports only once both spools have seen their end: reap closes the relays after the grace.

test.in: A linked worktree's .git is a file naming a gitdir under the parent's .git/worktrees; its refs and config live in the commondir beside it.
test.out: A linked worktree's .git is a file naming a gitdir under the parent's .git/worktrees.

test.in: The fork's go command starts each tool as itself -- the path of this executable would start the whole pipeline instead of the tool it named.
test.out: The fork's go command starts each tool as itself.

test.in: The step reads the file (the one named in go.mod, not the copy), and then it writes the answer back to the same place it came from, every time.
test.out: The step reads the file (the one named in go.mod, not the copy).
